notes.title: New Updates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

Thank you for submitting your feedback, reviews, and bug reports to us! 

As you may already know, we have been updating the game with bug fixes and various gameplay experience improvements (beware of spoilers!), and we have just released update 1.1.4 earlier today!

[u][b][h4]New Updates[/h4][/b][/u]
[b]General[/b]
[olist]
[*]Now, there are checkpoint saves in all episodes
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686693/3746a5c4ae9428057db0694be53e0dee0486cf05.png[/img]
[*]Light optimization - performance improvement in Seaside, Main Menu
[*]Post effects rework. The picture is less noisy and softer
[*]Fixed the problem with hieroglyphics in subtitles
[*]Small cosmetic changes to For Daddy to Work. Including a slight change to the swamp navigation and a minor redesign of the swamp corpses. [spoiler]Swamp corpses can now chase the player while he is not looking[/spoiler]
[*]Charleen Mufi'[spoiler]s priest has directly dialogue to make it clear he noticed you[/spoiler]
[*]Fixed bugs in all episodes[/olist]

[b]Goldi Vern (Highway)[/b]
[olist]
[*]The [spoiler]monster's[/spoiler] behavior has been improved
[*]Increased vehicle speed
[*]The farm quest has been slightly changed.[spoiler]You can climb out of the barn using the stairs and can be chased even after leaving the farm[/spoiler]
[*]Other [i]too many to list[/i] small changes have been done to improve the overall experience of this episode[/olist]

[b]Seaside (Hospital)[/b]
[olist]
[*][spoiler]To deliver the child to the father, you will face evil babysitters[/spoiler]
[*]Balance change for [spoiler]the babysitters[/spoiler]
[*]The Archive has been slightly reworked to make this episode more straightforward[/olist]

We appreciate reading all your feedback and reviews to make The Fridge is Red game even better!
Please play the game again, let us know your thoughts after these changes, and update your Steam reviews accordingly!
Many thanks from the development team!

[url=https://tblink.co/TFIRDiscord][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686693/26adaab4a6288cca6b4d8bc2478f544f10297aa1.png[/img][/url]

We wish you a great week and a [i]chilling[/i] Steam Scream Fest. Enjoy the game sale!

notes.title: The Fridge is Red new updates!
notes.notes:
Hell👁 evil appliance [i]aficionados[/i]!

We appreciate all the feedback and reviews we've received. Thanks to them, we have updated the game by fixing bugs and incorporating some of your gameplay suggestions. 

We have already fixed a few bugs and improved the performance and navigation hints on some of the most challenging levels, like [b][i]Charleen Mufi[/i][/b] and [i][b]Seaside[/b][/i].
You can find more details in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/1532460/discussions/0/3362524231624326665/]v1.0.8 patch notes[/url].

Right now, we're working to make the [i][b]Goldi Vern[/b][/i] episode with the highway more linear, which will make it easier to go in the right direction and shorten the driving part at the same time. 

We are also going to introduce automated saving checkpoints to make the experience more enjoyable. 

In addition, we’ll be introducing a new mechanic to the hospital episode ([i][b]Seaside[/b][/i]), which you will have to discover for yourself! 

Last but not least, we have introduced Steam Trading cards for the game!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39686693/17e1c4eaa64c3150097ebfded57a43f7b28e3833.png[/img]

Thanks again for your feedback, reviews and support. We encourage you to play again once the upcoming changes are live and tell us what you think on Steam Reviews!

Don't hesitate to join our community on [url=https://discord.gg/xHu2yjdYP2]Discord[/url] to share your experience directly with the Development Team.

notes.title: The Fridge is Red has been unleashed!
notes.notes:
Greetings, horror fans and evil appliance [i]aficionados[/i]!

Celebrate The Fridge is Red release with us! 
Are you prepared to find out what’s inside?

[previewyoutube=IoDT-8p1D4I;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]Get ready for six creepy tales.[/b]
Staring contest with the fridge monster. An Infinite maze of hospital hallways and archive backrooms. A haunted road trip along a frozen remote highway. A dreadful funeral ceremony, and a cursed elevator descending to the uncanny depths of the unknown.

Experience many more liminal spaces, surreal encounters and uncanny strangers in the full game. See you inside!

Huge thanks to everyone who played the early versions and the demo. We keep updating the game based on your feedback, which helps a lot.

notes.title: 📢 New trailer & demo: The Fridge is Red rebrands its name and joins tinyBuild!
notes.notes:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1532460/

Today, we're incredibly thrilled to share that the game formerly known as [i]Do Not Take Your Eyes Away From the Red Fridge[/i] joins the [b]tinyBuild[/b] family as [b]The Fridge is Red[/b].

[h1]Watch the Announcement Trailer[/h1]
[previewyoutube=Qcp2-a5gxzM;full][/previewyoutube]

[b]The Fridge is Red[/b] is a first-person psychological horror game with different unsettling liminal spaces and surreal events inspired by analogue horror of the PSX era; among which you will face a mysterious household fridge that will chill the hell out of you - and your groceries!

Open your mind to a fridge of chilling, terrifying scenarios...

[img]https://i.imgur.com/wCg4un6.gif[/img]

You can find the weirdest looking food within the Red Fridge... perhaps what you find is not food at all... are you brave enough to try it?

[img]https://i.imgur.com/EKLyNPR.gif[/img]

Look around wisely to find clues and solve mysteries to survive different challenges.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/WhsnX5N.gif[/img]

Check your surroundings, investigate, and [i]do not take your eyes away from the red fridge[/i]!

Play the demo and share your feedback in the comments below or on our official The Fridge is Red [url=https://discord.gg/xHu2yjdYP2]Discord[/url] server to keep in touch with other players and the developers! 
Make sure to subscribe to our newsletter and to follow our social media to stay up to date with all the important updates!

notes.title: Plans for the future!
notes.notes:
Hi all!

We originally made the game for [url=https://itch.io/jam/2020-epic-megajam]2020 EPIC MEGAJAM[/url] in one week, but we liked it so much that we decided to expand it into a full-fledged collection of short games.

The refrigerator story will serve as a prologue and serve as the beginning of the story and a kind of reference point for the future game.

Now we're working on a few more similar stories that will be connected by the same idea and full of experiments.
